ephrisian_tiktoklivelistener.name: TikTok Live Listener
ephrisian_tiktoklivelistener.description: Connect to the TikTok Overlay server and receive TikTok live events.

on-chat.description: Triggered when a viewer sends a chat message.

on-like-burst.description: Triggered when a viewer sends likes.

on-gift.description: Triggered when a viewer sends a gift.

on-share.description: Triggered when a viewer shares the stream.

on-follow.description: Triggered when a viewer follows the channel.

on-connected.description: Triggered when the listener connects to a live channel.

on-offline.description: Triggered when the channel is not live or its stream ends.

on-error.description: Triggered when the listener encounters an error.

on-connecting.description: Triggered when the listener begins connecting.

on-viewer-count-changed.description: Triggered when the live viewer count changes.

connect.description: Connect to a TikTok live channel.

session-id.name: Session ID or cookie
session-id.desc: Optional TikTok session ID or cookie.

authenticate-session.description: Save a TikTok session ID or cookie on the local overlay server.

session-id.name: Session ID or cookie
session-id.desc: TikTok session ID or full cookie string.

disconnect.description: Disconnect the listener and stop reconnecting.

set-server-url.description: Set the URL of the TikTok Overlay server.

user-id.description: User ID from the latest event.

profile-picture-url.description: Profile picture URL from the latest event.

message.description: Chat message from the latest chat event.

like-count.description: Count from the latest like burst.

total-likes-this-stream.description: Stream like total from the latest like burst.

gift-id.description: Gift ID from the latest gift event.

gift-name.description: Gift name from the latest gift event.

diamond-count.description: Diamond value of the latest gift.

gift-repeat-count.description: Repeat count of the latest gift.

viewer-count.description: Latest live viewer count reported by TikTok.

stream-id.description: Stream ID from the latest event.

last-event-json.description: Complete latest normalized event as JSON.

event-field.description: Read a field from the latest event.

field-name.name: Field name
field-name.desc: Name of the normalized event field.
